verification.notes: Duke University Libraries' description of an Emma Goldman primary-source exhibit explicitly states that Goldman became a mentor to Margaret Sanger and brought her into the campaign against the Comstock Law.

records.text: President William McKinley's assassin, Leon Czolgosz, was radicalized by Jewish Russian immigrant Emma Goldman.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The assassination of President McKinley done by a Polish man named Leon Czolgosz, who was radicalized by a Jewish Russian immigrant named Emma Goldman.

verification.notes: Czolgosz attended and was inspired by an Emma Goldman lecture shortly before assassinating McKinley; the source also makes clear Goldman did not instruct him to kill.

sources.title: Anarchism and Emma Goldman | American Experience | PBS
sources.relevance: Documents Czolgosz's attendance at and inspiration by Goldman's lecture while distinguishing inspiration from direction.

records.text: Emma Goldman was behind Margaret Sanger and Planned Parenthood.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She was also the woman that was behind Margaret Sanger, Planned Parenthood. Emma's boyfriend, also from the Pale of Settlement, tried to assassinate Henry Frick of the U.S. steel.

verification.notes: Goldman was an early mentor and birth-control influence on Sanger, but Sanger organized the bodies that became Planned Parenthood. The vague claim that Goldman was behind Planned Parenthood overstates her institutional role.

sources.title: Pioneers in Family Planning: Margaret Sanger, Rose Pastor Stokes, and Emma Goldman | Yale
sources.relevance: Describes Goldman's mentorship and Sanger's organizational role.

sources.title: Margaret Sanger and Birth Control | University of Michigan
sources.relevance: Documents Sanger's creation of the organization that became Planned Parenthood.
